thresholds.description: Optional sonar and battery rules. An active stream evaluates the shared sensor feed.

state_path.description: Literal object keys relative to the state_group value. IDs containing dots are single keys; do not split them.

frame.description: Coordinate frame for an axis reading, or null for a scalar.

source.description: Native key discovery, distinct from freshness/validity in state. Not a hardware verification claim.

Trajectory.description: Portable absolute joint trajectory. Times must increase strictly. Runtime joint limits and coupled timelines are checked before dispatch. Sparse per-joint timelines omit intermediate frames and hold after their last point.

replace_operation_id.description: Same-session finite motion to cancel before dispatch. Validation and resource admission precede cancellation.

restore_on_close.description: Opt into guarded restoration on orderly session close or lease expiry.

MotionPostureChanged.description: Partial native observation: only supplied fields changed; this is not an atomic posture/family snapshot.

MotionFallChanged.description: Observed fall-manager start/completion, not persistent physical state or proof of recovery. No synthetic standing event.

BatteryStateValue.description: ALBattery charge percentage observed through shared ALMemory sampling; null is unavailable, not empty.

quality.description: Optional source-specific distance quality, independent of state-group acquisition freshness. Measured denotes the documented nominal ranging interval, not a hardware verification claim.

SensorReading.description: A normalized reading. Null means unavailable/invalid, never zero or clear space. Units/frame are in the sensor catalog. Group quality and acquisition window still apply.

SensorStateValue.description: Value of the sensors state group. Passive readings use stable catalog IDs; motion, touch and battery share the usual group freshness envelope. Numeric zero and boolean false are valid.

SensorObserver.description: Session-owned demand for shared sensor producers. Active means the native subscription is confirmed and its software settling interval elapsed; it does not guarantee valid readings or a new native producer update. Stop removes this observer only.

speed.description: Fraction of discovered default step frequency.

MoveCreate.description: Relative to the robot at native execution start. At least one displacement component must be nonzero. The translation vector magnitude must be at most 1 metre.

MotionStopResult.description: The result of a motion.stop Operation after a stop attempt. Confirmation is native execution evidence. Joint confirmation is null for the locomotion scope.

VisionObserver.description: Session-owned demand for one shared vision detector. Active confirms the native subscription. Stop removes this observer only.

x.description: Forward velocity in metres per second.

y.description: Leftward velocity in metres per second.

yaw.description: Counterclockwise angular velocity in radians per second.
